name: XLA_AMB_SETUP_ERRORS
description: This table contains errors reported by the Create and Assign Source program and the Activate Journal Entry Rule Set program.

columns.name: AMB_ERROR_ID
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: MESSAGE_NAME
columns.description: Gives the  message name of the error or warning message.

columns.name: MESSAGE_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Describes whether it is a warning or error.

columns.name: CATEGORY_SEQUENCE_NUM
columns.description: Describes the order in which the messages will be displayed. How is this column populated. How do you know how to order these categories.

columns.name: MESSAGE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Describes the category of the message.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Internal development context of subledger accounting rule.

columns.name: PRODUCT_RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Owner for the application accounting definition.

columns.name: PRODUCT_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Code for the application accounting definition.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an entity and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event class and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event type and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the journal line rule is seeded.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_LINE_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to a journal line rule and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the description rule is seeded.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the elements of a description that appear on the subledger journal header and line. The definition determines both the content and sequence in which the elements of the description appear.

columns.name: ANALYTICAL_CRITERION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the supporting reference is seeded.

columns.name: ANALYTICAL_CRITERION_CODE
columns.description: Supporting reference short name.

columns.name: SEGMENT_RULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the account rule is seeded.

columns.name: SEGMENT_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of a rule to derive the account combination or segment value of a journal entry line.

columns.name: MAPPING_SET_CODE
columns.description: Short name of a mapping rule that is defined based on input source values to target segment or account.

columns.name: SOURCE_ORIGIN_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the subledger source or formula is predefined.

columns.name: SOURCE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the source is seeded

columns.name: SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the transaction information that is used to create journal entries.

columns.name: EXTRACT_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Database object that provides reference information on a transaction.

columns.name: EXTRACT_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Types of transaction object: translated header level, untranslated header level, translated line level, and untranslated line level.

columns.name: EXTRACT_COLUMN_NAME
columns.description: Database column name of a transaction object that provides reference information on a transaction.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Short name of the transaction and reference information from subledger applications or reference systems. Sources correspond to the transaction data available to be used in the accounting rules. A source is generally equivalent to a column in the data model of the application. For example, in Payables, the source Vendor Name refers to the name of the vendor associated to an invoice.

columns.name: MAPPING_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Accounting source group code.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the language into which the contents of the translatable columns are translated.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LINE_DEFINITION_OWNER_CODE
columns.description: User who creates the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: LINE_DEFINITION_CODE
columns.description: Journal entry rule set short name.

columns.name: SOURCE_APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of source application.

columns.name: MPA_ACCOUNTING_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Multiperiod journal line type owner code.

columns.name: MPA_ACCOUNTING_LINE_CODE
columns.description: Multiperiod journal line type code.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
